usage: ‘屋’ is commonly used to refer to a house or building where people live.
It is often combined with other words to specify types or parts of a house, such as ‘屋企’ (home) or ‘屋頂’ (roof).
It functions as a noun and can be used in both formal and informal contexts.
In Cantonese, ‘屋’ alone can mean a physical house, but adding context changes its meaning, such as ‘買屋’ (buy a house).
